blocks.text: 2 Samuel 7 contains 29 verses. It opens with: And it came to pass, when the king dwelt in his house, and Jehovah had given him rest from all his enemies round about, It concludes with: now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee; for thou, O Lord Jehovah, hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.
